name: MAIA + HydroGym Modular - Feature Selection Template
description: Copy this file to devcontainer.json and uncomment the features you need

./features/maia-gpu.description: MAIA GPU solver with NVHPC + CUDA stdpar (current workflow). Includes regression/profiling tools.

./features/maia-cpu.description: MAIA CPU solver with GCC + OpenMPI (gompi-like). For CPU-only development.

./features/nek5000.description: Nek5000 spectral element solver for HydroGym's 4 DRL cases (mini_channel, large_channel, naca0012_200k, small_wing), built from the in-repo third_party/nek5000 submodules + case sources. Independent of PETSc. Uses GCC + OpenMPI from base.

options.cases: comma-separated list of cases to build (default: all 4)

./features/petsc.description: PETSc 3.24.0 + OpenBLAS (required for Firedrake). Built with GCC + OpenMPI.

./features/firedrake.description: Firedrake FE automation + HydroGym CPU venv with [maia,firedrake,nek] extras. Requires petsc feature.

./features/python-ml.description: PyTorch (CUDA 12.8) + JAX (CUDA 12) + stable-baselines3 in venv. Uses pip-managed CUDA independent of system CUDA 13.2.

./features/hydrogym-gpu.description: HydroGym GPU venv with JAX-Fluids + HydroGym[maia,jax] extras. Requires python-ml feature.

./features/jax-fluids.description: JAX-Fluids standalone CFD solver in python-ml venv. Requires python-ml feature.

full-cpu-stack.description: MAIA CPU + Nek5000 + PETSc + Firedrake + HydroGym CPU + JAX (CPU). Pinned config: full-cpu-stack.devcontainer.json. Passes hydrogymExtras="maia,firedrake,nek,jax" to the firedrake feature so plain (CPU) jax lands in the same /opt/venvs/firedrake venv as hydrogym, instead of adding a separate ML feature.

full-gpu-stack.description: MAIA GPU + Python ML (PyTorch/JAX CUDA12/SB3) + HydroGym GPU (JAX-Fluids + HydroGym[maia,jax]). Pinned config: full-gpu-stack.devcontainer.json.

gpu-ml-stack.description: MAIA GPU + Python ML (PyTorch/JAX/SB3) + HydroGym GPU + JAX-Fluids as its own standalone feature (redundant with hydrogym-gpu's own JAX-Fluids install - prefer full-gpu-stack above unless you specifically need the jax-fluids feature's separate branch/repo override options)

everything.description: All features (large image, long build time ~2-3 hours)
